table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	C.CustCode,
	A.AliasName,
	A.Name As Customer,
	customercategoryname=(select customercategory.name from customercategory where customercategory.custcatcode=c.custcatcode),
	saleincount=(Select IsNull(count(SL.saleinvcode),0) From saleledger SL WHERE SL.custcode=A.AccCode and SL.date Between :ar_sdate AND :ar_ldate), 
saledisc=(Select IsNull(sum(S.net),0)
         From 	
               (SELECT SL.saleinvcode, Custcode=SL.Custcode, Net=Round(Sum (Round(( SD.looseqty  * (SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc) * (SD.discperc * .01)) + (SD.looseqty  * SD.itemflatdisc),2)), 2) + Round(Sum ( SD.looseqty   * (SD.saleprice  - SD.itemflatdisc) * (1 - (SD.discperc * .01))) * (SL.discperc /100), 2) + SL.flatdisc
					FROM  saleledger SL, saledetail SD
					WHERE SL.custcode=C.custcode and 
							SL.date Between :ar_sdate AND :ar_ldate AND
							SL.SaleInvCode = SD.SaleInvcode
					GROUP BY SL.saleinvcode,
						SL.CustCode,
						SL.discperc,
						SL.misccharges,
						SL.salestax,
						SL.flatdisc,
						SL.invgstperc1
					UNION ALL
               SELECT SL.saleinvcode, Custcode=SL.Custcode, Net=Round(Sum (Round(( SD.looseqty  * (SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc) * (SD.discperc * .01)) + (SD.looseqty  * SD.itemflatdisc),2)), 2) + Round(Sum ( SD.looseqty   * (SD.saleprice  - SD.itemflatdisc) * (1 - (SD.discperc * .01))) * (SL.discperc /100), 2) + SL.flatdisc
					FROM  saleledger SL, saleinvdetail SD
					WHERE SL.ImpactInventory = 'N' AND
							SL.custcode=C.custcode and 
							SL.date Between :ar_sdate AND :ar_ldate AND
							SL.SaleInvCode = SD.SaleInvcode
					GROUP BY SL.saleinvcode,
						SL.CustCode,
						SL.discperc,
						SL.misccharges,
						SL.salestax,
						SL.flatdisc,
						SL.invgstperc1) S
       		Where S.custcode=C.custcode), 

 saleamount=(Select IsNull(sum(S.net),0)
             From 	
               (SELECT SL.saleinvcode, Custcode=SL.Custcode,
						Net=Round(
							SUM((SD.looseqty*(SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc)) *
							(1 - (.01 * SD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SL.discperc)) + 
							SL.misccharges + SL.salestax - SL.flatdisc, 0)+
							Round(SUM( (SD.looseqty + SD.bonusqty) * SD.unitsalestax) + 
							SUM(ROUND( (SD.looseqty * (SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc)) *
								(1 - (.01 * SD.discperc)) * SD.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
							ROUND( (SUM((SD.looseqty * 
							(SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc)) *
							(1 - (.01 * SD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SL.discperc)) -
							SL.flatdisc) * (SL.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0)
					FROM saleledger SL, saledetail SD
					WHERE   SL.custcode=C.custcode and
						SL.date Between :ar_sdate AND :ar_ldate AND
						SL.SaleInvCode = SD.SaleInvcode
					GROUP BY SL.saleinvcode,
						SL.CustCode,
						SL.discperc,
						SL.misccharges,
						SL.salestax,
						SL.flatdisc,
						SL.invgstperc1
					UNION ALL
               SELECT SL.saleinvcode, Custcode=SL.Custcode,
						Net=Round(
							SUM((SD.looseqty*(SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc)) *
							(1 - (.01 * SD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SL.discperc)) + 
							SL.misccharges + SL.salestax - SL.flatdisc, 0)+
							Round(SUM( (SD.looseqty + SD.bonusqty) * SD.unitsalestax) + 
							SUM(ROUND( (SD.looseqty * (SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc)) *
								(1 - (.01 * SD.discperc)) * SD.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
							ROUND( (SUM((SD.looseqty * 
							(SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc)) *
							(1 - (.01 * SD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SL.discperc)) -
							SL.flatdisc) * (SL.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0)
					FROM saleledger SL, saleinvdetail SD
					WHERE SL.ImpactInventory='N' AND
						SL.custcode=C.custcode and
						SL.date Between :ar_sdate AND :ar_ldate AND
						SL.SaleInvCode = SD.SaleInvcode
					GROUP BY SL.saleinvcode,
						SL.CustCode,
						SL.discperc,
						SL.misccharges,
						SL.salestax,
						SL.flatdisc,
						SL.invgstperc1) S
       		Where S.custcode=C.custcode), 
	
	salereturn=(select IsNull(sum(	SR.Net),0)
		    FROM(SELECT Srledger.srinvcode,
				custcode=srledger.Custcode,
				net= IsNull( Round(sum(Round(((srdetail.looseqty + srdetail.packqty * srdetail.packunits) * srdetail.srprice) * (1 - (.01 * srdetail.discperc)),2)) * (1- (.01 * srledger.discperc)) + srledger.misccharges - srledger.flatdisc,0),0)
												 + /* Add Item level salestax*/
													Round( Round(	Sum (Round (dbo.srdetail.looseqty * dbo.srdetail.unitsalestax + Round ( Round ( dbo.srdetail.looseqty * dbo.srdetail.srprice * (1 - dbo.srdetail.discperc * 0.01 ), 2 ) * dbo.srdetail.gstperc * 0.01 , 2 ) , 2 ) )
												 + /* Add Invoice lever salestax*/
													Round ( (Sum ( dbo.srdetail.looseqty * dbo.srdetail.srprice) 
											 	 -    Round(Sum (Round( dbo.srdetail.looseqty  * dbo.srdetail.srprice * (dbo.srdetail.discperc * .01),2)), 2)     
											 	 -  Round(Sum (Round( (dbo.srdetail.looseqty  ) * dbo.srdetail.srprice * (1 - (dbo.srdetail.discperc * .01)),2)) * (dbo.srledger.discperc /100), 2)
											 	 - srledger.flatdisc ) * srledger.invgstperc1 * 0.01 , 2)
														,0)/* end of sales tax round*/	
													,0)/* end of main null function*/	

	FROM    srledger ,	 
	        srdetail 
		
			  
	WHERE   		srledger.custcode=C.custcode and
				srledger.date Between :ar_sdate AND :ar_ldate and
				srledger.SRInvCode = srdetail.SrInvcode

	GROUP BY Srledger.srinvcode,
		 Srledger.CustCode,
		 Srledger.discperc,
		 Srledger.misccharges,
		 Srledger.salestax,
		 Srledger.flatdisc,
		 Srledger.invgstperc1) SR
	where SR.custcode=C.custcode) 
From	Accounts A, Customer C
where C.custcatcode IN (:ai_custcatcode) and
      C.custcode=A.acccode
